tags.name: refused
tags.doc: A cap refused the edit; see `refusal` and `refused_source`.

types.name: editor.Editor
types.doc: The patch language's editor, the default.

fields.name: goal
fields.doc: What Up and Down aim for, kept across vertical moves.

types.name: editor.Palette
types.doc: Colours, straight RGBA, of an editor of language `L`: `classes` is indexed by `L.Class` (section 8).

types.name: editor.RowSlot
types.doc: A visible inline row: `walk` places it in the view's turtle; `rect` is where it lands.

types.name: editor.Style
types.doc: The text size and colours of an editor of language `L`.

fields.name: gutter
fields.doc: False: no line numbers, and the text starts `padding_px` into the viewport.

types.name: editor.buffer.Buffer
types.doc: The patch language's buffer, the editor's default.

fields.name: states
fields.doc: The language's state at the start of each line, one byte each.

fields.name: longest
fields.doc: Bytes of the longest line, LF excluded.

fields.name: tall
fields.doc: A sized language's tall lines, by line, the first `tall_cap` of them.

fields.name: revision
fields.doc: Moves on every change of the text, undo and redo included.

fields.name: undo_count
fields.doc: Entries `0 .. undo_count` are undoable, `undo_count .. entry_count` redoable.

fields.name: mark_base
fields.doc: The mark of the state before the oldest kept entry.

types.name: editor.buffer.Change
types.doc: The undo facts of one edit: its kind and the selections before and after it.

types.name: editor.buffer.Kind
types.doc: What an edit was, for merging (section 4).

types.name: editor.buffer.Selection
types.doc: A caret and the selection anchor, both byte offsets.

fields.name: bare
fields.doc: Written without an integer digit, as in `.25`.

types.name: editor.literal.Steps
types.doc: A widget's range of units at the value's decimals (section 2).

types.name: editor.tokenizer.Class
types.doc: Token classes; the value indexes the editor's palette.

types.name: editor.tokenizer.State
types.doc: The state carried from the end of one line to the start of the next.

types.name: editor.tokenizer.Token
types.doc: Bytes `start .. end` of the line, of `class`.

constants.name: editor.literal.literal_cap
constants.doc: Bytes of the longest literal: a sign, 9 digits, a point, and 6 decimals.

constants.name: editor.class_max
constants.doc: Classes a language has at most, so a palette is at most 16 colours.

constants.name: editor.default_palette
constants.doc: The language's class colours over the default chrome.

constants.name: editor.light_palette
constants.doc: The language's light class colours (`L.palette_light`, else `L.palette`) over a light chrome, for an app to set on a light scheme (section 8).

constants.name: editor.decoration_cap
constants.doc: Decorations an app may set: enough for every number literal in a full `lines_max` view of dense code (the live app's stress text needs about 1,060).

constants.name: editor.row_cap
constants.doc: Inline rows an app may set.

constants.name: editor.lines_max
constants.doc: Lines one draw shows at most; a taller viewport leaves the rest empty.

constants.name: editor.columns_max
constants.doc: Columns one line shows at most.

constants.name: editor.glyph_max
constants.doc: Glyphs one draw appends at most: the text cells and the gutter numbers.

constants.name: editor.tall_cap
constants.doc: Lines above level 0 a text keeps; the rest of them stay body lines.

constants.name: editor.padding_px
constants.doc: Space above the first line and below the last.

constants.name: editor.Editor.default_palette
constants.doc: The language's class colours over the default chrome.

constants.name: editor.Editor.light_palette
constants.doc: The language's light class colours (`L.palette_light`, else `L.palette`) over a light chrome, for an app to set on a light scheme (section 8).

constants.name: editor.language.class_max
constants.doc: Classes a language has at most, so a palette is at most 16 colours.

constants.name: editor.language.scale_max
constants.doc: Sizes a language has at most.

constants.name: editor.tokenizer.palette
constants.doc: The default colours, straight RGBA, indexed by `Class`.

constants.name: editor.tokenizer.palette_light
constants.doc: The colours on a light background (`EditorOf(L).light_palette`), indexed by `Class`.

functions.name: editor.literal.parse
functions.doc: Parses `[-] digits [. digits]` or `[-] . digits` (section 1), or null.

functions.name: editor.literal.format
functions.doc: Writes `fixed` with exactly its decimals; the bare style holds only below 1 (section 1).

functions.name: editor.literal.rescale
functions.doc: `fixed` in steps of `decimals` decimals, rounded `way` when it has more.

functions.name: editor.literal.steps
functions.doc: The units a widget over `lo ~ value ~ hi` moves between (section 2), or null when there is no room at the value's decimals.

functions.name: editor.literal.pow10
functions.doc: Ten to the power `exponent` as an integer; `exponent` is at most `decimals_max` plus `integer_digits_max`.

functions.name: editor.literal.to_f32
functions.doc: The value of `fixed` as an `f32`: its units divided by ten to its decimals.

functions.name: editor.literal.to_f64
functions.doc: The value of `fixed` as an `f64`: its units divided by ten to its decimals.

functions.name: editor.literal.shift
functions.doc: Moves each edge of `range` at or after byte `at` by `delta` (section 4).

functions.name: editor.literal.moved
functions.doc: `byte` moved by `delta`, which must not move it before the start of the text.

functions.name: editor.literal.write
functions.doc: Rewrites `range` of `editor` (an `*EditorOf(L)`) with `fixed`, through `replace`, so inside an open gesture it joins that gesture's undo entry (section 3).

functions.name: editor.EditorOf
functions.doc: The editor of language `L` (`language.zig`; section 8).

functions.name: editor.PaletteOf
functions.doc: Colours, straight RGBA, of an editor of language `L`: `classes` is indexed by `L.Class` (section 8).

functions.name: editor.StyleOf
functions.doc: The text size and colours of an editor of language `L`.

functions.name: editor.Token
functions.doc: Bytes `start .. end` of a line, of `class`.

functions.name: editor.glyph_bound
functions.doc: Glyphs one draw appends at most in a viewport `width` by `height` logical pixels at text `size` (section 4): per drawn line, its gutter digits and the columns from two left of the clip to its right edge.

functions.name: editor.lines_bound
functions.doc: Lines one draw shows at most in a viewport `height` logical pixels tall at text `size`: those whose tops fall inside it, plus the one the top edge cuts.

functions.name: editor.glyph_bound_of
functions.doc: `glyph_bound` for language `L`.

functions.name: editor.lines_bound_of
functions.doc: `lines_bound` for language `L`, whose pitch comes from its faces (section 4).

functions.name: editor.line_height_of
functions.doc: The line pitch of language `L` at `size`.

functions.name: editor.Editor.init
functions.doc: An empty editor.

functions.name: editor.Editor.load
functions.doc: Replaces the text with `utf8`, sanitized (`edit.sanitize_text`), clears the history, and puts the caret at the start, scrolled home.

functions.name: editor.Editor.text
functions.doc: The whole text, as the buffer holds it.

functions.name: editor.Editor.revision
functions.doc: Moves on every change of the text, undo and redo included.

functions.name: editor.Editor.selection
functions.doc: The selected byte range, ordered.

functions.name: editor.Editor.caret_position
functions.doc: The caret's line and codepoint column, both from 0.

functions.name: editor.Editor.first_visible_line
functions.doc: The first line the current scroll shows.

functions.name: editor.Editor.viewport
functions.doc: The viewport of the last draw.

functions.name: editor.Editor.rect_of
functions.doc: The logical rect of the character at `byte` (section 2).

functions.name: editor.Editor.replace
functions.doc: Replaces `range` with `utf8` as one undo entry, or as part of an open gesture; the caret and anchor follow the text.

functions.name: editor.Editor.replace_keeping
functions.doc: `replace` with the selection the caller works out, kept in the undo entry so redo restores it: for an edit that moves text, whose caret should move with it.

functions.name: editor.Editor.gesture_begin
functions.doc: Starts a gesture on the buffer: every edit until `gesture_end` joins one undo entry.

functions.name: editor.Editor.gesture_end
functions.doc: Ends the open gesture, so the next edit opens an undo entry of its own.

functions.name: editor.Editor.history_mark
functions.doc: The history mark for a dirty marker (`editor/buffer.zig`, section 4).

functions.name: editor.Editor.view_id
functions.doc: The id of the editor's scrolling view, derived from its own id.

functions.name: editor.Editor.handle
functions.doc: Applies one event; see the module guide, sections 3 and 5.

functions.name: editor.Editor.undo
functions.doc: Takes back the last edit, as Ctrl+Z does, for an app that routes the key itself.

functions.name: editor.Editor.redo
functions.doc: Restores the last edit undone, as Ctrl+Y does.

functions.name: editor.Editor.x_of
functions.doc: The x of `byte` on `line`, relative to column 0 (section 2).

functions.name: editor.Editor.byte_at_x
functions.doc: The byte of `line` nearest the x `x`, relative to column 0: the walk stops at the first codepoint whose middle lies right of it, as `@round` does on the grid.

functions.name: editor.Editor.widest_px
functions.doc: The widest line in pixels: a walk of the whole text, once per revision and size.

functions.name: editor.Editor.content_height
functions.doc: The height of every line and row with the padding (section 2).

functions.name: editor.Editor.draw
functions.doc: Draws the editor in the view `walk` places, all of it except inline rows (section 6).

functions.name: editor.Editor.draw_begin
functions.doc: Opens the view and draws the lines, selection, decorations, and caret.

functions.name: editor.Editor.next_row
functions.doc: The next visible inline row, with the view's turtle skipped to its top, or null.

functions.name: editor.Editor.draw_end
functions.doc: Skips the turtle to the end of the content and closes the view.

functions.name: editor.buffer.Buffer.init
functions.doc: An empty text with no history.

functions.name: editor.buffer.Buffer.load
functions.doc: Replaces the whole text with `utf8` (valid UTF-8 without tabs or CRs; see `edit.sanitize_text`) and clears the history.

functions.name: editor.buffer.Buffer.text
functions.doc: The bytes of the whole text, `len` of them.

functions.name: editor.buffer.Buffer.line_range
functions.doc: The bytes of line `line`, LF excluded.

functions.name: editor.buffer.Buffer.line_bytes
functions.doc: The text of line `line` as a slice, LF excluded; `line_range` gives its offsets.

functions.name: editor.buffer.Buffer.line_of
functions.doc: The line holding byte `byte` (the last line for the end).

functions.name: editor.buffer.Buffer.replace
functions.doc: Replaces `range` with `utf8` (valid UTF-8 without tabs or CRs, `range` on codepoint boundaries) and records it for undo.

functions.name: editor.buffer.Buffer.seal
functions.doc: Closes the open entry, so the next edit opens its own (section 4).

functions.name: editor.buffer.Buffer.gesture_begin
functions.doc: Starts a gesture: every edit until `gesture_end` merges into one entry.

functions.name: editor.buffer.Buffer.gesture_end
functions.doc: Ends the open gesture and seals its entry; one must be open.

functions.name: editor.buffer.Buffer.amend_after
functions.doc: Replaces the selection the open entry restores on redo, for an edit whose final selection is known only after its last replace (an indent of several lines).

functions.name: editor.buffer.Buffer.undo
functions.doc: Reverts the newest undoable entry and returns the selection before it, or null.

functions.name: editor.buffer.Buffer.redo
functions.doc: Re-applies the oldest redoable entry and returns the selection after it, or null.

functions.name: editor.buffer.Buffer.history_mark
functions.doc: The mark of the current state of the history (section 4).

functions.name: editor.buffer.Buffer.verify
functions.doc: Checks every invariant of the module guide, section 5.

functions.name: editor.buffer.Buffer.level_at
functions.doc: The level of `line`: its entry in `tall`, by binary search, else 0.

functions.name: editor.language.Token
functions.doc: Bytes `start .. end` of a line, of `class`.

functions.name: editor.language.class_count
functions.doc: The number of `L.Class` tags.

functions.name: editor.language.proportional
functions.doc: True when `L` sets each class in its own face (section 1).

functions.name: editor.language.scaled
functions.doc: True when `L` sizes its lines (section 1).

functions.name: editor.language.check
functions.doc: The first reason `L` is not a language, naming `L` and the declaration, or null.

functions.name: editor.language.end_state
functions.doc: The state at the end of `line` when it starts in `start`.

functions.name: editor.language.verify_line
functions.doc: Walks `line` from `start`, asserting the rules of section 2 at every token, and returns the end state.

functions.name: editor.tokenizer.next
functions.doc: The next token of `line` at or after `at.*`, which advances past it; `state` carries a block comment across lines.

functions.name: editor.tokenizer.end_state
functions.doc: The state at the end of `line` when it starts in `start`.
